categories.question: You are setting the table for a fairy picnic in a hollow tree. What is the centrepiece?

outcomes.name: A thimble of violets
outcomes.description: Tiny silver thimble serving as a vase for a few purple violets

outcomes.name: A walnut boat of berries
outcomes.description: Half walnut shell filled with miniature berries and a tiny leaf sail

outcomes.name: A buttercup candleholder
outcomes.description: Golden buttercup flower cupping a single tiny glowing wax candle

outcomes.name: A pinecone cake stand
outcomes.description: Small cake stand balanced on a pinecone with a tiny berry tart on top
